title: Notice Periods and Payment Windows — HomeGuard Homeowners Policy
content:
Eight fixed periods govern notices and payment windows on the HomeGuard Homeowners Policy. All are counted in calendar days. Seven are the same on every package; the reinstatement window differs.

## Timetable

| Period (calendar days) | HO-3 Essential | HO-3 Enhanced | HO-3 Premier | HO-5 Enhanced | HO-5 Premier | HO-5 Signature |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Days past an installment due date after which a nonpayment notice is issued if the installment is still unpaid | 15 | 15 | 15 | 15 | 15 | 15 |
| Days between the nonpayment notice date and the scheduled cancellation date | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 |
| Days between an underwriting cancellation notice date and the scheduled cancellation date | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 |
| Minimum days of advance written notice of nonrenewal before the expiration date | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 |
| Days of advance notice owed to the mortgagee before a cancellation takes effect | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 |
| Days before expiration the renewal offer and first renewal installment are billed | 45 | 45 | 45 | 45 | 45 | 45 |
| Days after expiration a late renewal payment is still accepted to renew with a lapse | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 |
| Days after a nonpayment cancellation date within which reinstatement may be requested | 15 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 45 |

Column headings shorten HomeGuard HO-3 Essential, HomeGuard HO-3 Enhanced, HomeGuard HO-3 Premier, HomeGuard HO-5 Enhanced, HomeGuard HO-5 Premier and HomeGuard HO-5 Signature.

## The periods in words

- **Nonpayment notice.** 15 calendar days past the installment due date; the notice is issued after that period if the installment is still unpaid.
- **Nonpayment cancellation date.** 10 calendar days after the nonpayment notice date.
- **Underwriting cancellation date.** 30 calendar days after an underwriting cancellation notice date.
- **Nonrenewal notice.** At least 30 calendar days of advance written notice before the expiration date.
- **Mortgagee notice.** 10 calendar days of advance notice to the mortgagee before a cancellation takes effect.
- **Renewal offer.** Billed 45 calendar days before expiration, together with the first renewal installment.
- **Late renewal payment.** Accepted up to 30 calendar days after expiration, renewing the policy with a lapse.
- **Reinstatement window.** Reinstatement may be requested within the package's window after a nonpayment cancellation date: 15 days on HomeGuard HO-3 Essential, 45 days on HomeGuard HO-5 Signature, and 30 days on the other four packages.

## Dates worked from hypothetical anchors

The anchor dates below are hypothetical.

| Hypothetical anchor | Period applied | Resulting date |
|---|---|---|
| Nonpayment notice dated 3 March | 10 days | scheduled cancellation date 13 March |
| Underwriting cancellation notice dated 3 March | 30 days | scheduled cancellation date 2 April |
| Expiration date 30 June | 45 days before | renewal offer billed 16 May |
| Expiration date 30 June | 30 days after | late renewal payment still accepted on 30 July |
